relationships.subject: Capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Capsaicin, the active component of the chili pepper, is known to activate the transient receptor potential vanilloid 1 (TRPV1), sensitize peripheral sensory nerve fibers and induce gut nociception.40

key_findings: Germ-free mice show greater visceromotor responses to colorectal distension in both sexes.
DRG neurons from germ-free mice produce more CGRP (not substance P) upon GPCR agonist stimulation, mainly in females.
